sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next for Local AI in 2026: 180B on Disk, 6B Active, and ...
sources.snippet: Honest take: If you own a 24GB card, keep running Qwen3.8-27B and skip this entirely. If you own a 96-128GB unified-memory box, Flash-Next is the best local model you can run today — and its weird architecture (tiny KV cache, SSD-streamable embeddings) is a preview of what local inference looks like in 2027.
